blocks.orig: Tarangire Safari Lodge is a combined lodge and tented camp in the north of Tarangire National Park, with some of the most amazing views of the park. The safari tents, with thatched roofs and mesh-screened windows, welcome you to rest comfortably after your game drive. For more space, you can opt for a circular bungalow, built in a style similar to the Masai bomas. All tents and bungalows have their ensuite bathroom with solar-heated showers and 24-hour electricity. Whether you relax on your private terrace, jump in the pool, enjoy dinner in the open-air dining room or sip cocktails at the bar and lounge area, everything comes with stunning panoramic views.
blocks.html: With some of the most amazing views of the park, Tarangire Safari Lodge is part lodge, part tented camp, located in the north of Tarangire National Park. Back from a game drive, you can rest in comfort in the safari tents, which have thatched roofs and windows with mesh screens. Need more room? Then a round bungalow is an option, built much like the bomas of the Masai. Tents and bungalows alike have their own ensuite bathroom with solar-heated showers, and there is electricity around the clock. From your private terrace, the pool, the open-air dining room at dinner time or the bar and lounge with a cocktail, the panoramic views are stunning wherever you are.
